headline: West Alabama's first win makes them the top scorers
dek: West Alabama had drawn one and lost four before Saturday, and then beat Tuskegee at home for their first win of the season. Their fourteen goals are now the most of any programme in the conference, and they have still conceded thirteen.
displaced_by: West Alabama's first win of the season, at home to Tuskegee, takes them past UAH as the conference's top scorers

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The tallest bar is not the strongest side: West Alabama have scored fourteen and conceded thirteen, and have won once in six matches.

wire.line: UAH and Trevecca, both still unbeaten, meet each other in the first week of conference play.

findings.label: observed

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hunter Walker has conceded three goals for Trevecca and kept three clean sheets.

findings.label: observed

next_match.line: Mississippi Christian have scored in every match this season, and won their conference opener at home to Union.
